ventures.title: MATE.md
ventures.description: MATE.md is a low-level relationship state protocol for autonomous or semi-autonomous agents. It defines a portable, human-readable, machine-parseable way for one agent to declare bond state toward another, with consent, policy references, event references, and proofs. Best fit: open commons/protocol, not a standalone venture.
ventures.revenueModel: Not a core revenue product; value comes from adoption, reference implementations, and adjacent services.
ventures.lessons: MATE.md is better framed as commons infrastructure than a venture. The protocol has a real interoperability need across agent runtimes, and the repo already contains a credible core spec, schema, examples, and Nostr extension draft.
